# I Like My Teeth

> > A comprehensive resource hub for water fluoridation advocacy, dental health education, and evidence-based public health information.

I Like My Teeth is a campaign-driven educational platform partnered with the Campaign for Dental Health, dedicated to promoting community water fluoridation and oral health prevention. The site provides targeted resources for health professionals, water operators, scientists, and the general public to understand fluoridation safety, efficacy, and implementation.

## Key Topics

- Community Water Fluoridation
- Water Fluoridation
- Fluoride Safety
- Dental Health
- Oral Health Prevention
- Cavity Prevention
- Dental Fluorosis
- Tooth Decay Prevention
- Public Health
- Fluoride Education
- Health Professionals
- American Academy of Pediatrics
- Campaign for Dental Health
- Fluoride Research
- Children's Dental Health

## Core Resources

- [I Like My Teeth](https://ilikemyteeth.org): Homepage introducing I Like My Teeth's water fluoridation and oral health mission.
- [About I Like My Teeth](https://ilikemyteeth.org/about): About page detailing Campaign for Dental Health partnership and organizational mission.
- [Water Fluoridation Overview](https://ilikemyteeth.org/fluoridation): Main fluoridation page covering water fluoridation debate, safety, and health expertise.
- [Partner Organizations & Allies](https://ilikemyteeth.org/allies): Directory of partner organizations and allies in dental health and water fluoridation advocacy.

## Professional Resources

- [Health Professionals Hub](https://ilikemyteeth.org/health-professionals): Resource hub for health professionals on water fluoridation and dental fluorosis.
- [Water Operators Guide](https://ilikemyteeth.org/waterops): Guide for water operators on community water fluoridation implementation and safety.
- [Oral Health Prevention Primer](https://ilikemyteeth.org/ohpp): Oral Health Prevention Primer training guide for pediatricians on fluoride education.
- [Scientific Evidence & Research](https://ilikemyteeth.org/scientists): Scientific evidence and research resources on water fluoridation from major institutions.

## Educational Content

- [Fluoridation Debate Overview](https://ilikemyteeth.org/debate-fluoridation): Evidence-based overview of community water fluoridation debate and public health policy.
- [Learn & Share](https://ilikemyteeth.org/learn-share): Educational content on fluoridation myths, fluorosis prevention, and cavity prevention.
- [Shareable Content & Infographics](https://ilikemyteeth.org/share): Shareable content and infographics on water fluoridation and cavity prevention.
- [Animated Toothbrushing Video](https://ilikemyteeth.org/learn-and-share/animated-toothbrushing-video): Animated educational video on toothbrushing with fluoride toothpaste for cavity prevention.
- [Parent Fluoride Questions](https://ilikemyteeth.org/learn-and-share/new-resource-fluoride-questions-parents-ask): Parent resource infographic answering common fluoride and children's dental health questions.

## FAQ & Community Engagement

- [Fluoride Questions FAQ](https://ilikemyteeth.org/fluoridation/fluoride-questions): FAQ addressing fluoride effectiveness, tooth decay prevention, and public health evidence.
- [Public Opinion on Water Fluoridation](https://ilikemyteeth.org/learn-and-share/public-opinion-on-water-fluoridation-what-americans-think-and-how-to-reach-them): Research findings on public opinion and messaging strategies for water fluoridation advocacy.
- [Blog](https://ilikemyteeth.org/blog): Blog featuring fluoride safety, water fluoridation research, and dental health news.

## Resources & Support

- [Resource Directory](https://ilikemyteeth.org/resources): Comprehensive resource directory for fluoridation, oral health, and professional associations.
